dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.text: Let us start the meeting. Everyone has the agenda, right?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, I have it. The first point is the new project.

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.text: Correct. How is the project going so far?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: It is going well, but we are two days behind schedule.

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.text: What do you suggest we do about it?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I suggest that we add one person to the team this week.

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.text: That is a possibility. Does everybody agree?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I agree, and I can write the report about the changes.

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.text: Thank you. Please send it to me by Friday.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: No problem. I will send it on Thursday afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.text: Perfect. Is there anything else before we finish?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Just one thing: could we meet again next Monday?
